# Android Mupen64Plus-Next 3.0 / 15bada8

These are unmodified official Libretro Buildbot archives, retained for explicit
Nintendo 64 Setup. `provenance.json` records the original URLs, exact archive and
ELF hashes, ABI/dependencies, source archive, recipe and component notices.

The logical Broomm core is `mupen64plus_next`; its Android filename is
`mupen64plus_next_gles3_libretro_android.so`. ARM builds identify 3.0-Vulkan;
x86 builds identify 3.0-GLES3. Every ABI embeds source `15bada8`.
The corresponding pinned source is linked in the provenance record. The full
upstream NDK build environment has not been reproduced. Retained recipe inputs
are reference material, not a claim of bit-for-bit reproduction.

Only the requested core is downloaded at Setup. These archives add no emulator,
firmware or game payload to Broomm's application package. Core and component
licenses remain applicable. Native execution and gameplay are separate checks.
